name: evaliqa
description: Send Claude Code sessions to EvaliQA for evaluation. Ships the session transcript so a trace carries the agent's own answer and what Agent, AskUserQuestion and MCP calls returned, which OpenTelemetry spans never do.

evaliqa_url.title: EvaliQA URL
evaliqa_url.description: Base URL of your EvaliQA host, e.g. https://your-evaliqa-host. Leave empty to disable sending.

evaliqa_api_key.title: EvaliQA API key
evaliqa_api_key.description: Project API key (evx_…) from your EvaliQA project's Tracing tab. Stored in secure credential storage, never in settings.json. Leave empty to disable sending.
